description: Choose how to discover public Acquire.com startup-for-sale listings, then narrow them by financials, location and company details.

businessModels.description: Case-insensitive words to find in the seller's business-model tags, e.g. Subscription, B2B, B2C, DTC, Ecommerce, Services, Marketplace, Freemium, Licensing.
businessModels.title: Business model keywords

categories.description: Only return these Acquire categories. Legacy names such as Mobile Apps, Services and Digital Marketing Agency are matched to their current category.
categories.title: Categories

connectedMetrics.description: Keep listings that show a Google Analytics traffic section.
connectedMetrics.sectionDescription: Optional badges and document signals published on the listing.
connectedMetrics.title: Only listings with Google Analytics

customers.description: Minimum customer count. When Acquire shows a range such as 1,000-5,000, the lower bound is compared.
customers.title: Min customers

financingTypes.description: Only return listings funded in one of these ways.
financingTypes.title: Financing

includePublicDetails.description: Fetch public startup details from Acquire's Firebase documents for returned listings: marketplace status and status history, first-listed date, financial snapshot, recast SDE, Google Analytics traffic, views/favorites/conversations, file-count breakdown and seller flags. Adds up to two extra requests per returned listing.
includePublicDetails.sectionDescription: Optional additive fields from Acquire's public Firebase documents. The public listing page remains the primary source.
includePublicDetails.title: Include public Firebase details

locations.description: Country or region names to match against the listing's location, case-insensitive. Leave empty for every location.
locations.title: Seller locations

maxAge.description: Maximum age derived from the listing's Date Founded year.
maxAge.title: Max business age (years)

maxAnnualGrowthRate.description: Upper bound for the year-over-year revenue growth percentage.
maxAnnualGrowthRate.title: Max annual growth rate (%)

maxAnnualRecurringRevenue.description: Backward-compatible name for a maximum annual / TTM revenue.
maxAnnualRecurringRevenue.title: Max annual revenue (USD)

maxArr.description: Skip listings whose disclosed annual recurring revenue is above this amount.
maxArr.title: Max ARR (USD)

maxConcurrency.description: How many public listing pages to request at once. Higher values finish large runs faster; lower values are gentler on the source.
maxConcurrency.title: Concurrent page fetches

maxCustomers.description: Maximum customer count, using the lower bound of a displayed range.
maxCustomers.title: Max customers

maxItems.description: Maximum number of listing records to save. The public marketplace currently has about 1,250 listings.
maxItems.title: Max listings

maxPrice.description: Skip listings whose asking price is above this amount.
maxPrice.title: Max asking price (USD)

maxProfitMultiple.description: Upper bound for asking price divided by trailing-twelve-month net profit.
maxProfitMultiple.title: Max profit multiple

maxRevenueMultiple.description: Upper bound for asking price divided by trailing-twelve-month revenue.
maxRevenueMultiple.title: Max revenue multiple

maxScan.description: Optional safety cap on how many public pages to inspect before stopping. 0 means no extra cap beyond maxItems and the sitemap.
maxScan.title: Max listings to inspect

maxTTMGrossRevenue.description: Skip listings whose trailing-twelve-month gross revenue is above this amount.
maxTTMGrossRevenue.title: Max TTM revenue (USD)

maxTTMNetProfit.description: Skip listings whose trailing-twelve-month net profit is above this amount.
maxTTMNetProfit.title: Max TTM profit (USD)

minAge.description: Minimum age derived from the listing's Date Founded year.
minAge.title: Min business age (years)

minAnnualGrowthRate.description: Year-over-year revenue growth percentage. Use a negative value to include declining listings.
minAnnualGrowthRate.title: Min annual growth rate (%)

minAnnualRecurringRevenue.description: Backward-compatible name for a minimum annual / TTM revenue. Prefer Min TTM revenue for new tasks.
minAnnualRecurringRevenue.title: Min annual revenue (USD)

minArr.description: Skip listings whose disclosed annual recurring revenue (ARR) is below this amount. Listings without ARR are skipped.
minArr.title: Min ARR (USD)

minPnlDocuments.description: Minimum number of P&L documents the listing says are available.
minPnlDocuments.title: Min P&L documents

minPrice.description: Skip listings whose asking price is below this amount. Listings shown as Open to offers have no numeric price and are skipped by a price filter.
minPrice.sectionDescription: Optional deal filters. Leave a field empty to skip it.
minPrice.title: Min asking price (USD)

minProfitMultiple.description: Asking price divided by trailing-twelve-month net profit.
minProfitMultiple.title: Min profit multiple

minRevenueMultiple.description: Asking price divided by trailing-twelve-month revenue.
minRevenueMultiple.title: Min revenue multiple

minSupportingFiles.description: Minimum number of supporting files the listing says are available.
minSupportingFiles.title: Min supporting files

minTTMGrossRevenue.description: Skip listings whose trailing-twelve-month gross revenue is below this amount. Listings without a disclosed figure are skipped.
minTTMGrossRevenue.title: Min TTM revenue (USD)

minTTMNetProfit.description: Skip listings whose trailing-twelve-month net profit is below this amount. Negative values are accepted.
minTTMNetProfit.title: Min TTM profit (USD)

mode.description: How to find listings. `auto` uses your URLs when present, a text search when `searchQuery` is set, and otherwise walks the public sitemap.
mode.title: Mode

openToOffersOnly.description: Keep listings whose asking price is shown as Open to offers.
openToOffersOnly.title: Only open-to-offers listings

priceReducedOnly.description: Keep listings showing a Price Reduced badge. No live instance was observed in the full public inventory at the last check.
priceReducedOnly.title: Only price-reduced listings

proxyConfiguration.description: Leave empty to connect directly. The actor automatically tries a free platform datacenter proxy if the source starts blocking the run.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Optional connection override. No proxy is required.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration (optional)

recastFinancials.description: Keep listings whose public page shows the Recast financials badge or highlight card.
recastFinancials.title: Only recast-financials listings

searchQuery.description: Words to look for in the listing title, description, highlights, category, location, business model, tech stack, competitors and assets (mode=search). All words must appear.
searchQuery.title: Keyword search

sortBy.description: How to order matches. Newest and oldest use the sitemap's last-updated time. Financial sorts scan the candidate set and put listings without that figure last.
sortBy.sectionDescription: How many listings to return and how to order them.
sortBy.title: Sort order

teamSizes.sectionDescription: Optional filters over the company overview and acquisition details.
teamSizes.title: Team size

techStack.description: Case-insensitive technologies to find in the seller's tech-stack list, e.g. WordPress, Shopify, Laravel, React, AWS.
techStack.title: Tech stack keywords

underAdvisory.description: Keep listings carrying Acquire's Guided by Acquire advisory badge.
underAdvisory.title: Only Guided by Acquire listings

urls.description: Specific Acquire.com listing links (mode=byUrls). Accepts /public/<slug> and /startup/<slug> links, with or without https://app.acquire.com. Sign-in URLs (/startups/<id>) cannot be read anonymously.
urls.title: Listing URLs

verifiedBusiness.description: Keep listings carrying Acquire's public Verified business highlight (US entities with a verified address and incorporation certificate).
verifiedBusiness.title: Only verified businesses

title: Acquire.com Public Startup Listings Input
